lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, quasi-circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four vertical columns on the visible lateral flank, forming a regular 2D grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with horizontal ridges; high-intensity blobs are frequently centered at these intersections, functioning as grid anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three parallel horizontal carinae are visible across the mid-lateral body, characterized by distinct luminance gradients with sharp highlights on the superior surfaces and shadows on the inferior surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The primary dorsal fin displays a major structural anomaly where the distal apex is missing or truncated, presenting a flat and irregular dorsal margin consistent with previous amputation or trauma.
